messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Hey team — quick preflight for the Sept 14 joint webinar with NimbusEdge and CloudCart. Need to lock speaker order, AV requirements, and a hardware fallback plan.
Liam (Events): timeline? I can block rehearsal slots. prefer 45min run + 15min buffer.
Olivia (SolutionsEng): Speakers confirmed: Maya (intro), Darren (HW demo), Priya (CloudCart deep-dive). Can we do a dry-run with the full demo chain? last time KV-cache warmup caused lag.
Darren (HW Partner): We can ship two loaner units for the on-site demo and a dockerized fallback that runs on host GPUs. Shipping ETA to your office: Sep 7 if we label as expo gear.
Maya (Partnerships): Perfect. Liam — can you reserve 9/12 11:00-11:45 PT for the full rehearsal (A/V + demo)? Also we need a "plan B" checklist in case loaner units delayed.
Liam (Events): Reserved. I'll add AV contact (Ava) and include Zoom RTMP details. Need input: video codec preference? we usually do H.264 baseline.
Olivia (SolutionsEng): H.264 is fine. For plan B: pre-recorded demo + live Q&A, and ability to switch to CloudCart-hosted inference model for latency demo. I'll prepare a short script and an S3 link with the recording.
Maya (Partnerships): Good. Darren — please confirm power/adapter needs, and whether the loaner units require any firmware update before the show. Also we need a short speaker bio (1-2 lines) for the event page.
Darren (HW Partner): Power: standard IEC C13, 2U rack-ish form factor but can do desktop. No mandatory firmware update; we'll ship with v2.1. Bio: "Darren K — Dir of Product Partnerships, NimbusEdge. Leads edge integration and partner demos." Sending as DM now.
Liam (Events): AV asks: on-stage HDMI + backup DisplayLink, wired ethernet for each demo box (1Gb), 2x lav mics, one headset for the host. Also we need a stage tech 20 mins before.
Maya (Partnerships): Noted. Swag: swagbot, can you confirm sticker/tote counts and vendor pickup window? We want partner co-branded tees (S-M-L) and 200 sticker packs.
swagbot: ETA for pick-up: Sep 10-11. Inventory: 200 sticker packs, 120 tees (limited S/M), recommend 60 additional sticker reprints to cover walk-ups.
Olivia (SolutionsEng): Rehearsal checklist I will upload to the shared drive: command-line for demo bring-up, env vars, and fallback launch command. Example snippet: ```bash
export MODEL_URL=https://s3.redwood-inference/demos/nimbus-edge/model-v1
./start_demo.sh --no-gui --fallback-host cloudcart.example.com
```
Maya (Partnerships): Great. Final to-dos: 1) Darren confirm shipping label + courier by EOD Tue, 2) Liam confirm AV contact and stage tech, 3) Olivia upload recording + runbook, 4) I will send speaker bios and event page copy. Anyone object to the run-of-show: 5min intro / 18min Demo 1 / 12min Demo 2 / 10min partner Q&A / 5min CTA?
Darren (HW Partner): That split works for us. Can we flip Demo 1/2 if network latency spikes?
Olivia (SolutionsEng): Yes, we'll design demo gating so we can swap order without slides changes — just a different endpoint.
Maya (Partnerships): OK. If no objections I'll mark this as preflight green and post the rehearsal invite.
Liam (Events): All good from events side. Adding Ava (AV) and stage tech to rehearsal invite.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: rehearsal-recording-bucket creation at 2026-09-10T09:00:00Z (provisioning).
Maya (Partnerships): Thanks all — ping if anything changes. I'll post the final checklist 9/8. :thumbsup:
